product.title: Red Rock Canyon with Rocky Gap 4x4 Adventure
product.description: Travel from Las Vegas into Red Rock Canyon and continue into the Rocky Gap backcountry for a route that blends scenic interpretation with technical 4x4 terrain. The itinerary emphasizes key sandstone viewpoints, geology context, and the rougher Rocky Gap section that distinguishes this trip from standard scenic-drive alternatives.
highlights: Combined Red Rock Canyon sightseeing and Rocky Gap 4x4 route in one guided outing.
Geology-focused commentary on Aztec sandstone layers and desert erosion patterns.
Multiple scenic pullouts for named viewpoints and photo stops.
Small-group pacing with dedicated off-road segment beyond standard scenic loops.
additionalInfo: Terrain can be bumpy during the Rocky Gap segment.
Bring sun protection and weather-appropriate layers.
Pickup timing depends on selected departure and hotel access restrictions.
Not recommended for travelers with back injuries.

items.title: Las Vegas pickup and departure
items.description: Depart from your assigned Las Vegas pickup point and travel toward the Red Rock Canyon area.

items.title: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Loop entry
items.description: Enter the conservation area and begin guided narration on Mojave Desert ecology and sandstone geology.

items.title: Calico Hills overview
items.description: Stop for views of layered red and cream sandstone formations and fault-line tilting patterns.

items.title: High Point Overlook
items.description: Pause at one of the scenic loop's broadest lookouts for photos over the Red Rock escarpment.

items.title: Willow Springs area
items.description: Interpretive stop focused on native plants, petroglyph context, and desert adaptation.

items.title: Rocky Gap trailhead
items.description: Transition from paved scenic roads to rougher 4x4 terrain with guide-led speed management.

items.title: Rocky Gap wash and ledge route
items.description: Navigate uneven wash crossings and rocky shelves that define the dedicated off-road section.

items.title: Return toward Las Vegas
items.description: Exit Rocky Gap and transfer back to Las Vegas pickup areas.

faqs.question: Does this tour include both Red Rock Canyon and Rocky Gap?
faqs.answer: Yes. The route includes scenic Red Rock Canyon viewpoints plus a separate Rocky Gap 4x4 terrain segment.
